title: LibreDWG AcDs scan safety and local boundary crosswalk
mode: Primary-source open-PR review plus local source/test audit, followed by generated regression implementation
scope: Review the newly visible LibreDWG AcDs/ACIS marker-scan safety proposal and distinguish reported peer behavior from local behavior.
Check the exact libdxfrw AcDs marker scanner and existing generated DataStorage regression owner for an analogous boundary condition.
Record adjacent new peer safety proposals as discovery-only when only their titles or issue-index summaries were reviewed.
Add bounded generated marker-tail controls to the existing test owner without adding a fixture, changing routine validation cadence, or promoting support.

sources.revision: Open pull request against master; reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The proposal describes a decompressed AcDs scan using memmem for ACIS BinaryFile. A recovery offset can advance beyond the buffer, after which dat->size - i underflows as size_t and is passed as a huge haystack length. The author reports an ASan reproduction with a standalone copy of the loop and reports unchanged discovery of three blobs in the existing AcDs sample.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer-reported reproducer and proposed fix only. The proposal remained open in the reviewed snapshot; no peer code was built or executed here. It does not establish a libdxfrw defect, file-format rule, or ACIS semantic support.

sources.observed: The page identifies Windows nightly 0.14.8612 at commit f860b0f on 2026-10-13 and lists it separately from stable 0.14.1.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Artifact-index evidence only. A later open PR is not part of either artifact unless merged and rebound to a new source/build.

sources.revision: Open PR/issue index snapshot reviewed 2026-10-19; title-level review for these items
sources.observed: Titles expose candidates involving ASSOCASMBODYACTIONPARAM/3DSOLID field-offset invalid-free, 64-bit vector-count multiplication, JSON count/buffer agreement, DXF LTYPE dash bounds, FIELD lifetime, and XDATA string alignment.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Discovery leads only. This pass did not review those diffs or reproduce the reports; no root cause or local defect is asserted.

sources.observed: The initial source/test audit found findAcisBinaryFileMarker scans each retained payload with a fixed marker-length guard and DataStorage record ranges are checked against section/segment bounds. The existing generated test initially covered a marker near the start and following sentinel record; the later fast implementation added complete-final-offset and partial-tail marker cases with suffix preservation.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Static review of the named scanner plus focused generated regression only. It found no analogous size_t-underflow loop but is not a whole-parser memory-safety audit or a support qualification.

assessment.validation: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_graph_preservation_tests -j4 passed; ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^libdxfrw_graph_preservation$' --output-on-failure passed 1/1 in 0.88 sec; scoped git diff --check passed.
assessment.planImpact: The plan records the peer issue as comparative/discovery evidence and the follow-through adds two generated end-boundary marker assertions to the existing DataStorage test owner. Implementation order, fast validation cadence, fixture policy, and all support claims remain unchanged.
